description:
Cast Shield Sphere.
Untap Blasting Station.
Equip Sword of the Realms to Shield Sphere for {0}.
Activate Blasting Station, sacrificing Shield Sphere deal 1 damage to any target.
Sword of the Realms triggers, returning Shield Sphere to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms
